visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman wearing a pink baseball cap with a white A logo and a white collared shirt speaks directly to the camera in a bright restaurant setting. Her facial expression is cheerful as she explains something. Behind her are empty dining tables with teal chairs and a large glass door reflecting bright outdoor sunlight. (2) The camera pans to show framed monochrome portraits on a white wall. The woman’s hand enters the frame, pointing to portraits of the characters Jessie and Buzz Lightyear from Toy Story. The frames are gold-colored, and the lighting is even across the wall. (3) The camera continues panning to show portraits of Miguel and his dog Dante from the movie Coco. The woman continues to point at the portraits, which are arranged in pairs horizontally along the middle of the wall. (4) The next pair of portraits features the rat Remy and the human Linguini from Ratatouille. Below the portraits is a white wainscoting panel. A small green potted plant is visible in the foreground on a counter. (5) The camera shows portraits of Bo Peep and Woody from Toy Story. These portraits are black and white, depicting the characters in profile or three-quarter views. The girl's hand remains in the frame as a guide. (6) The woman points at a portrait of Elastigirl next to Frozone from The Incredibles. She pauses and looks back at the camera with a confused, questioning facial expression, her mouth slightly open and eyebrows raised. (7) A fast-cut sequence starts with a close-up of the woman’s face looking shocked and confused, then flashes to a dramatic zoom-in on Frozone's face in the portrait. The editing pace increases significantly to emphasize the comedic mistake in the pairing.
